up: List the distinct molecules that are reported in the document identified by ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1221220'. For each such molecule, return its ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). If a molecule has no canonical SMILES, still include it with a NULL value for that field. Deduplicate so that each molecule appears only once. Sort the results by molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1221220' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
